production costs associated with the restart of the San Cipri&aacute;n smelter.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font quarter 2026 operational tax expense to approximate $65 million to $75 million, which may vary with market conditions and jurisdictional profitability.</font></p><p With a values-based approach that encompasses integrity, operating excellence, care for people, and courageous leadership, our purpose is to Turn Raw Potential into Real Progress. Since developing the process that made aluminum an affordable and vital part of modern life, our talented Alcoans have developed breakthrough innovations and best practices that have led to greater efficiency, safety, sustainability, and stronger communities wherever we operate.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Discover more by visiting www.alcoa.com.   <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="text-indent:-3.448%;padding-left:3.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(3)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.695pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">      </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The tax impact on special items is based on the applicable statutory rates in the jurisdictions where the special items occurred. The noncontrolling interest impact on special items represents Alcoa&#x2019;s partner&#x2019;s share of certain special items.</font></p><p style="text-indent:-3.448%;padding-left:3.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(4)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.695pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">       </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In any period with a Net loss attributable to Alcoa Corporation (GAAP or as adjusted), the average number of common shares applicable to diluted earnings per share exclude certain share equivalents as their effect is anti-dilutive.</font></p><p style="margin-left:3.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the quarter ended December 31, 2025, undistributed earnings of $2 and undistributed earnings &#x2013; as adjusted of $3 were allocated to preferred stock under the two-class method. For the quarter ended September 30, 2025, undistributed earnings of $3 were allocated to preferred stock under the two-class method. For the quarter ended December 31, 2024, dividends paid on preferred stock were $1, and undistributed earnings of $2 and undistributed earnings &#x2013; as adjusted of $3 were allocated to preferred stock under the two-class method.</font></p><p style="margin-left:3.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the year ended December 31, 2025, dividends paid on preferred stock were $1, and undistributed earnings of $15 and undistributed earnings &#x2013; as adjusted of $13 were allocated to preferred stock under the two-class method. For the year ended December 31, 2024, dividends paid on preferred stock were $1, and undistributed earnings of $3 and undistributed earnings &#x2013; as adjusted of $5 were allocated to preferred stock under the two-class method.</font></p></div>

Net margin is equivalent to Sales minus the following items: Cost of goods sold; Selling, general administrative, and other expenses; Research and development expenses; and Provision for depreciation, depletion, and amortization. Adjusted EBITDA is a non-GAAP financial measure. Management believes this measure is meaningful to investors because Adjusted EBITDA provides additional information with respect to Alcoa Corporation&#x2019;s operating performance and the Company&#x2019;s ability to meet its financial obligations. The Adjusted EBITDA presented may not be comparable to similarly titled measures of other companies.</font></p><p style="text-indent:-3.448%;padding-left:3.333%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:6.7pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(1) </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.695pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">       </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Special items include the following (see reconciliation of Adjusted Income above for additional information):</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="margin-left:3.463%;display:flex;margin-top:6pt;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1.602%;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:1.659467354485845%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">&#x2022;</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8.5pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, the mark-to-market contracts associated with the Portland, Australia smelter generated losses ($9) in Other expenses (income), net which economically increase the cost of power recorded in Cost of goods sold and the mark-to-market contracts associated with the San Cipri&aacute;n refinery and smelter generated gains ($7) in Other expenses (income), net which economically offset a portion of foreign currency impacts recorded in Cost of goods sold. Management believes this measure is meaningful to investors because management reviews cash flows generated from operations after taking into consideration capital expenditures, which are necessary to maintain and expand Alcoa Corporation&#x2019;s asset base and are expected to generate future cash flows from operations. It is important to note that Free cash flow does not represent the residual cash flow available for discretionary expenditures since other non-discretionary expenditures, such as mandatory debt service requirements, are not deducted from the measure.</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Net Debt and Adjusted Net Debt</font></p><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>
